description: Which honua-server markdown is part of the Open Knowledge Format bundle, and which is deliberately not. Consumed by scripts/ci/check-okf-bundle.py.

spec.name: Open Knowledge Format
spec.note: One markdown file is one concept; the file path is the concept's identity; relative markdown links are the graph edges. `type` is the only required frontmatter field.

conceptTypes.index: A section entry point. Enumerates what the directory holds so a reader or agent can choose before opening.
conceptTypes.concept: What a thing is and how it fits. No procedure.
conceptTypes.guide: A task someone performs, start to finish.
conceptTypes.reference: Lookup material: surfaces, options, contracts, matrices.
conceptTypes.runbook: A remediation procedure an alert or an error payload points at.

excludedDirs.why: Contributor notes, ADRs, spikes and evidence, flattened together. Reachable from its own README, not from SUMMARY.md. Needs its own curation pass before path-as-identity means anything here.
Superseded pages kept for history. Publishing them as concepts would put retired claims back into the graph.
Capability data and client-certification evidence. The JSON under docs/gis/data is the generated spine other gates read; the markdown beside it is evidence, not prose documentation.

excludedFiles.why: GitBook's table of contents. It is navigation over the bundle, not a concept in it.
Dated status report, superseded by each successor rather than maintained.
Dated execution evidence for one fixture run, not product documentation. Belongs with the other evidence under docs/internal; excluded here until it is moved.

rejectedFields.timestamp: Not an OKF field in any version. The trust family spells the build stamp `generated`; honua-site emitted `timestamp` until 2026-09-10 and the mistake must not spread here.

includedFiles.why: Linked from SUMMARY.md as Compatibility -> CITE status, so it is published documentation despite being dated.
Linked from SUMMARY.md. Re-included over the docs/gis exclusion because it is a published procedure, not evidence.
Linked from SUMMARY.md. Re-included over the docs/gis exclusion because it is a published matrix, not evidence.
The doorway into docs/internal. The tree stays out of the bundle; its entry point is listed in SUMMARY.md and so must be a concept — OKF's `index` is exactly this role.
Doorway into the demo runbooks, listed in SUMMARY.md.
Doorway into the historical archive, listed in SUMMARY.md.

summaryIsInBundle: Every SUMMARY.md link target under docs/ must be inside the bundle. If a page is in the table of contents it is published documentation, and published documentation is a concept.
